1.t: Order to Be Assigned to the Bokutou Traffic Department
1.o: Saori realizes her dream of being a cop, and joins the Bokutou traffic department

2.o: Goukon is a group date thing that Yoriko gets the gang to try out for a night. Saori doesn’t think it’s appropriate, so the gang spins it around and convince her to go along as an “undercover cop”. It turns out there’s been a purse stealer who’s been frequenting those events. Will Saori be able to do her duty and still have some fun?

3.o: A beast has been wreaking havoc by the waterside and the Bokutou station is assigned to chase him. It’s a monkey that Natsumi’s boyfriend has been befriending. They eventually, with his help, are able to find the monkey.

4.o: Bokutou station has been modernized to the latest automated police equipment from a robotic vending machine to GPS installations to terminals acting as patrol units. How will the gang deal with the new changes?

5.o: A mysterious creature has been rampaging through some local shops

6.o: A movie star is caught speeding and asks the station for help in allowing him and his girlfriend, who he’s been hiding from the public, to be able to go on a date without the paparazzi hounding them. The gang works out a decoy plan

7.o: Strike man is back and helps Natsumi hunt down a recycling information-theft ring

8.t: Go Around and Round! The Two's Coffee Cup
8.o: Ken and Miyuki take Honda's daughter Megumi to an amusement park.

9.o: Yoriko’s rival is back and challenges her to a flag team competition in the next parade. Yoriko gets Natsumi, Miyuki, Aoi, and Saori involved. In the meantime, there’s a stalker who has the hots for Yoriko!

10.o: Honda gets called away for another job, this time a race mechanic, but Megumi forgets to tell him about an upcoming family event (like father-daughter show and tell) at school. Miyuki rushes to the race site to find Honda, but will it be in time?

11.t: Major Panic on the Bokutou Line (1)
11.o: Miyuki and Natsumi have a roommate situation fight, and Natsumi goes off for a while. Miyuki meets up with some engineers who show her a new robot that can do heavy operations. In the meantime a major earthquake hits the area and the subways are shut down. Natsumi is on the subway by the way.

12.t: Major Panic on the Bokutou Line (2)
12.o: The gang continue to clear people out of the subway line, but the tunnels are collapsing due to the earthquake aftershocks and water. This blocks out a small group of folks. Will Miyuki be able to save the folks trapped inside, including Natsumi?

13.o: A celebrity actress joins the Bokutou police force to practice for her upcoming movie role. Natsumi and her encounter a fake cop that has a self-righteous attitude.

14.t: C'est Se Bonne, Shaking Loving Heart
14.o: Nakajima rescues a cat and the gang wants to celebrate. He gets drunk and calls Miyuki who’s running late, to propose and ends up telling her he needs more space from her. Whooops! In the meantime, there’s an assignment where Nakajima and Miyuki are forced to couple up undercover to unravel a food cart related car stereo/equipment theft.

15.o: Daimaru’s wife Sena shows up at Nakajima’s house, cooking and cleaning. It turns out she and Daimaru had a fight over Daimaru’s forgetting the day they first met. After having Sena over at the gals’ place, the gang try to figure ways for them to get back together. But the couple is strong willed. Nakajima tries to talk Daimaru into apologizing, but he refuses. Nothing seems to be working. Sena goes driving to their special place on Sunday and meets a guy who still likes her and starts driving aggressively against her, but Daimaru then shows up and all is well.

16.t: How to Correctly Make an Internet Friend
16.o: Aoi has been text messaging on the Internet, and now a guy wants to meet her in Tokyo, except he doesn’t know Aoi is a guy. Aoi gets the gang to help chase the guy down

17.t: A Curse on a Midsummer's Night
17.o: The gang unintentionally break some sealed up box stand in the park and strange things start happening at Bokutou station. There’s a legend of a police woman who haunts the place. Then the lights go out, there’s blood and heads and all sorts of visions. Miyuki and all start freaking out

18.o: Chief tells Natsumi that he has something important to tell her in private. Natsumi thinks Chief might still have some feelings for her. So she struggles between her feelings for Chief and her boyfriend who happens to be in town. Eventually, the Chief gets some time alone with her, and it turns out he was recommending Natsumi for a promotion.

19.o: Natsumi thinks about her promotion to the special forces. She talks with her boyfriend about it, and he believes that’s what she always wanted and he’ll support her. Miyuki realizes the reality that she could be dependent on Natsumi. Miyuki goes wandering around and ends up at a car parts showcase she sees Honda-san. They have a heart-to-heart talk about what it means to let go for someone’s career.

20.t: The Bus Stop that Passed By
20.o: Natsumi packs and travels to the training grounds of her new job. Miyuki ponders some more and then starts shopping for herself and also for some gifts she can give her friends. Miyuki drops by the Zapper store to give Honda’s daughter Megumi a gift. But Honda just left for the bus station, and Megumi calls his cellphone. Miyuki goes to the bus stop to give the cellphone to Honda. At the bus stop they talk for a while and Miyuki breaks down and cries on Honda’s lap. Nakajima spots only the last part where they are hugging.

21.t: The Man, Nakajima, Bear With It
21.o: Nakajima struggles with the possibility that Miyuki might be in a relationship with Honda-san. He imagines several scenarios where she dumps him. Nakajima tries in some situations to tell her his feelings, but ends up as usual changing the subject. In the meantime, Natsumi returns to Boukutou on special assignment. They all have dinner together, but Nakajima goes off early to think about things more. He goes to a beach and helps some kids catch a hat that’s fallen in the water.

22.o: The tension is still increasing between Miyuki and Nakajima. The chief has a new assignment for everyone: to patrol for speeders taking residential road short-cuts that are off-limits during school/daytime hours. After lunch, Natsumi senses there’s still aloofness between Miyuki and Nakajima. She confronts Nakajima but he gets upset and leaves. Natsumi then confronts Miyuki and Miyuki responds with a SLAP! Uh oh.

23.o: Following their fallout, Miyuki then requests to be assigned a different partner. Natsumi is partnered with Saori for the rest of the speeders mission. Everyone kind of moves on with their assignment.

25.o: The bridge is nearing completion and the gang need to decorate for the opening ceremony.

26.o: Nakajima wins a trip to a hot springs resort and musters up enough courage to ask Miyuki out. With the rest of the gang tagging along, will Nakajima finally get to propose?

1.o: Ricco's father-in-law turns out to be Rita's high school sweetheart. Meanwhile, Rita's battle at school with a 14-year-old know-it-all goes wrong.

2.o: A new student suffers socially when his parents demand a schoolwide ban on sugar. Meanwhile, Rita's estranged mother wants to get back in touch.

3.o: When a school talent show forces Rita to re-evaluate her uncompromising relationship to truth, she realizes she's been doing some lying of her own.

4.o: Rita finds porn on Jeppe's computer and fears he'll share what she knows firsthand is a destructive relationship to sex.

5.o: Rita protects a troubled kid with ADHD from vandalism charges but forgets to fight for her own son when he's the victim of hate crime bullying.

6.o: Rita finds drugs at school, but the accused student points Rita in the direction of her own son, Jeppe. Molly gets a job at a hospice.

7.o: When Rita takes over a second-grade theater production, her own life story begins to blend with the fairy tale the kids are playing out.

8.o: A lonely Rita starts hanging out with Rosa. But all hell breaks loose when Rosa realizes that Rita was the one her dad was having an affair with.

1.o: A pregnant Rita faces a difficult decision: She can keep the baby but never reveal who the father is, or she can get an abortion.

2.o: Rita and Rasmus move in together, and Rita tries her best to act like an adult -- until Rasmus puts a rose bed in her beloved wilderness of a garden.

3.o: Rita "lends" her own grandchild to a pregnant girl in her class in an attempt to convince her to get an abortion, but the plan backfires.

4.o: It's sports day, and Helle wants to protect the losers from having an upsetting experience -- but Rita takes up the struggle for the right to win.

5.o: Another teacher is terrorizing Rita's student, and Rita has to take up the cause -- but it's not easy when the teacher uses bureaucracy as a weapon.

6.o: A student in Rita's class falls hopelessly in love with her at the same time that her own first love, Tom, reappears in her life at a family baptism.

7.o: Rita and Rasmus struggle to save their relationship, but an innocent meeting with a colleague has unexpected consequences.

8.o: For the first time in her life, Rita has gone down for the count, but she has to rediscover her fighting spirit when Erik strikes a student.

1.o: Inspired by local politics, Rita holds an election in her class. Uffe gets a job at the school, but it sparks conflict with Hjordis.

2.o: Helle hires a motivational coach for the students. Meanwhile Jeppe moves in with his boyfriend, and Rita struggles with living on her own.

3.o: A problem student goes on a destructive rampage, Hjordis makes progress with her second graders, and a man from Rita's past shows up.

4.o: To combat loneliness, Rita invites some students to her house. Meanwhile, Hjordis tries to spice up her sex life with Uffe.

5.o: Rita's fourth graders come down with head lice, and she decides to delouse them herself. Meanwhile, Helle faces evaluation by her peers.

6.o: Rita tries to keep the police in the dark when Hjordis decides on the perfect item to bury in a time capsule: marijuana.

7.o: Overcome by stress, Helle asks Rita to become the school's temporary headmaster, and Hjordis's class celebrates Saint Lucy's day with style.

8.o: Rita agrees to act as temporary headmaster in Helle's absence, and Hjordis and Uffe face an important decision regarding their relationship.

1.o: Rita has settled down in Molly's apartment and works in a burger bar, much to Molly's chagrin. When Molly, on behalf of Rita, sends a job application, Rita ends up with a job offer from her former primary school, which she reluctantly accepts. Hjørdis, out of concern for Rita, applies for a job at the same school, so she can be there for her.

2.o: Rita, who hates cooking, struggles to fill in as a home economics teacher. Hjørdis tries to help Allan overcome his fears about an upcoming field trip.

3.o: A bomb threat scares the whole school — except Rita. Hjørdis worries that her and Uffe's strange hobbies will hurt their son socially when he's older.

4.o: Lea invites Rita to join her family for dinner, echoing a day in 1985 when teenage Rita had dinner with Lea's parents and was called to Lea's rescue.

5.o: When one of Rita's first-graders doesn't want to take a turn bringing home 'Sharebear,' the class teddy bear, she visits his home to find out why.

6.o: To try to save the school from closure, the staff organizes a fundraiser, including a play by Hjørdis' class with Allan in the lead role.

7.o: Bjørne can't bear to break the bad news to his staff and becomes self-destructive. The event in 1985 that led to Lea falling out with Rita is revealed.

8.o: When history starts to repeat itself, Rita retreats in self-defeat, until a loyal friend gives her the support she needs to figure out her future.

1.o: A young Holocaust denier creates a scare at Hjordis and Rita's school. Helle asks Rita to help Rasmus accept a hard truth. Uffe meets a kindred spirit.

2.o: Rita tries to stop a shy student's parents from uprooting him to move to Greenland. Rasmus meets someone on Tinder. Hjørdis helps a student face a fear.

3.o: During a field trip to Sweden, Rita rubs the local townsfolk the wrong way. Niels brings Jeppe back to Denmark, where Rasmus and Uffe help the two bond.

4.o: When an odd new student suddenly pops up in class, Rita gets a moneymaking idea. Jeppe goes on a Tinder date. Attraction grows between Rasmus and Rita.

5.o: Uffe tries to avoid Pil. Rita worries that one of her night-class students might be a victim of domestic abuse. Jeppe learns Ole is still in the closet.

6.o: Jeppe's ex unexpectedly returns. Hjørdis helps a student whose parents use her as a go-between. Rita's friendship with Gerd becomes a problem in class.

7.o: Rita struggles to process her overwhelming feelings of guilt. Ole reveals to Jeppe that he's met someone else - whom his grandmother approves of.

8.o: Jeppe learns that Ole is going to propose to Camilla. A new student who leads the other pupils in a school strike reminds Rita why she became a teacher.

1.o: Morra was orphaned and had a difficult childhood. Now, she is married to an unemployed man. She meets someone who offers him a profitable job.

2.o: Morra goes to the wedding of her ex to harass him and ends up getting arrested. In the meantime, El-Khawaga presents Shehata with a bizarre proposal. When Morra gets back home, she is in for a tragic and bloody surprise.

3.o: Turns out Morra faked her children’s death after she agreed to sell them to El-Khawaga for money. She flees the village after she kills her husband, Shehata.

4.o: Morra goes to Alexandria with the money and lives in a small hotel owned by a lady named Doreya. She meets Sultan who works as a taxi driver as he struggles to get back the land that his uncle had stolen from his late father.

5.o: Sultan is arrested at a checkpoint and goes downtown. Morra meets a man from her village who follows her to learn where she is staying but she eludes him. Doreya suspects her mysterious character. When Sultan is released, he proposes to Morra.

6.o: Morra gets closer to Sultan and suggests they partner up to open a restaurant on the land he inherited. His uncle and his son try to stop this partnership. Morra lends Hanan money for her husband’s surgery. The restaurant collapses due to an earthquake with Sultan inside.

7.o: After losing everything with the restaurant, Morra works as a maid at Doreya’s. Fathi sells their apartment to pay Morra back and moves with Hanan to Cairo. A police investigator asks about Morra at the hotel, and they tell him that she isn't living there anymore. El- Khawaga visits Doreya.

8.o: Doreya wants to buy an infant from El-Khawaga. When Morra overhears them, she spills a drink on his jacket to steal his house keys. She later breaks into his house, learns where he sent her children and takes the money that she believes is her due. She gets a new identity and reports Doreya.

9.o: Morra moves to Cairo and marries Tariq Altamimi, a successful businessman. In 2012, his two daughters, one of whom is actually Morra’s, do not get along with her at all despite the years they have lived together.

10.o: Morra sees a therapist, Reyad, for ulterior motives and meets Gamila, his daughter. Tariq faces some serious business problems. Kareem gets hired at Altamimi’s company. Dina finds ominous spellwork in her room and her father’s.

11.o: Dina fights with Tariq over the spellwork she found and storms out of the house. She hits someone as she drives away in tears. Morra cuts a deal with the victim’s family to pay them half a million pounds if they drop the charges. Gamila tells her father that she met Morra at a concert.

12.o: Tariq competes with El-Halwagy over a business tender. Naima blackmails Morra into working at her orphanage, which is a facade for a “business” Morra is starting as she doesn’t register some of the orphaned kids. Dina falls for the son of her father’s lawyer.

13.o: Morra is determined to sabotage the budding romance between Dina and Ahmed. She finds some financial inconsistencies at her orphanage and threatens her accountant. Rana and Karim grow a bit closer after the argument they had, and she starts to like him.

14.o: Tariq tells his family about the imminent financial crisis. Morra suggests an illegal action to avoid bankruptcy and he firmly rejects it. Morra’s therapist confronts her with her lies, so she shocks him with the truth about his daughter. She sells an infant to a powerful government official.

15.o: Reyad is shocked that Morra knows the truth about his daughter, Gamila. Karim tells Rana that he likes her. A face from Morra’s past shows up at the orphanage, asking to meet her.

16.o: Abd al-Azim blackmails Morra. Karim tells his parents about Rana. Tariq wins the tender, and El-Halwagy tries to find any mistakes to hold against him to seize the project from him.

17.o: Morra gets rid of Abd al-Azim. She tries to seduce Reyad, and sabotage Ahmed & Dina’s relationship. She asks her mole in Tariq’s company to find any mistakes to hold against him.

18.o: Tariq assigns Karim to a project secretly and tells Morra that he asked for Rana’s hand which upsets her. Gamila meets Morra to tell her that Reyad has fallen for her. Karim takes his parents to Tariq’s home to propose to Rana, and Morra is surprised to discover that they are Fathi and Hanan.

19.o: Morra rejects Karim’s proposal and threatens Tariq with divorce if he insists on this marriage. Nabil’s wife meets Dina to tell her to stay away from Ahmed. Tariq follows a lead on Reyad. El-Halwagy finds out that Morra is married to Tariq.

20.o: Tariq suspects that Morra is having an affair with Reyad. Nabil discovers that Emad is the one to set his son up. Morra visits Hanan at her house and threatens her to make Karim stay away from Rana. El-Halwagy meets Morra, and asks her to help him get rid of Tariq’s competition.

21.o: Morra agrees to help El- Halwagy in return for a cut from his profits from the project. Tariq tells Morra that he met Reyad who told him she was depressed and suicidal. Morra plots with her mole, Ezat, to get a file that can make Tariq lose the project.

22.o: Gamila tells Morra to stay away from her father. Ezat tries to sabotage Karim and Tariq’s relationship and learns that Karim has the file he was supposed to give to Morra. Dina learns that Morra defamed her, and sabotaged her relationship with Ahmed.

23.o: Morra threatens to harm Emad if he slips. Reyad quarrels with Morra and tells her to stay away from him and his daughter. Karim accidentally finds out about Morra and Ezat's plot to destroy Tariq. Dina tells Rana what she found out.

24.o: Morra offers Karim 10 million pounds in return for the file and recordings. El-Halwagy decides to get rid of Karim and sends gunmen to shoot him. Tariq reveals to Morra that he has a heart condition, and he wants to write all his wealth over to her and his daughters.

25.o: Ahmed takes the shot instead of Karim. El-Halwagy is infuriated about the mess-up and doesn't believe Morra when she tells him that Ahmed is his son. When Morra visits Ahmed at the hospital, she finds Karim there, and he tells her he wants 25 million pounds. Tariq has a big surprise for Morra.

26.o: Turns out Karim told Tariq everything, and he exposes her before the girls. Morra is arrested which freaks El-Halwagy out. Morra denies all charges. Tariq leaves the project to Karim and liquidates the company.

27.o: Karim and Rana decide to get married. El-Halwagy visits Ahmed in hospital. Morra finds her way around the prison and manages to get hold of a cell phone. She calls Emad and makes a deal with him.

28.o: Karim lands a job opportunity abroad. Emad tells Nabil that Morra wants to see him. When he meets her, she tells him she is Ahmed’s real mother, so he gets her out of jail. She later tells Tariq she wants 30 million pounds or she will tell Rana that she is her real mother.

29.o: Morra blackmails Reyad to stay silent about Gamila, so he tells Gamila the whole truth about Morra being her mother. El-Halwagy tells Ahmed that he is his real father. Gamila goes to Tariq’s and meets Rana and Ahmed. The police find the link between Morra and Abd Al-Azeem.

30.o: Some time passes. A journalist visits Morra in jail after she survives an incident. She tells him her life’s story, and how she chose money over her children even when they went to see her. She is sentenced to death.

1.o: Mysterious buttons appear in the worlds of Tanya the Evil, KonoSuba, Overlord, and Re:Zero. When the characters push them, they're taken to a place they'd never imagined...

2.o: Now that everybody's settled in, it's time for the first day of school, which means everybody has to introduce themselves.

3.o: The students begin to wonder about why they are here, and what this school really is. Tanya, in particular, has a theory about Ains...

4.o: The students realize that they're all from other worlds, and begin to share their backgrounds. But some are luckier than others...

5.o: It's time for the talent show, but none of the students are talented at all. The KonoSuba crowd in particular...

6.o: It's time to pick the class rep! But Aqua doesn't want Ains to do it, and Albedo doesn't want Aqua anywhere near the job.

7.o: Emilia's the class rep now, but it's really hard. But she wants to do her best!

8.o: It's time for a field trip to the beach, and the gang's getting ready. But who wants to see Kazuma in a swimsuit?

9.o: The field trip is here, and it's great! Everybody's at the beach and having a great time. But Tanya hears something that makes her upset...

10.o: It's time for Field Day, and Roswaal hints that whoever wins will get to go home. But then they meet their opponents...

11.o: Field Day is here, and it's lots of fun for everyone. There's tug of war, scavenger hunts... and giant robots?!

12.o: The mobile fortress "Destroyer" has joined the last game! It's up to the quartet to grab its headband and win the game.

1.o: The students have now finally settled into their new lives, but a new student has come to the school, and his name is… "Shield"?

2.o: Life's great in this world, except for one thing: there's no alcohol! When the students sneak into the principal's office to get their fix from his stash, they run into more than they bargained for.

3.o: This new world is a great place: no fighting, no danger, and the classes are easy. But you REALLY don't want to get detention!

4.o: It's time for a test! Everybody expects Ains to score highly, but… he never even passed middle school!

5.o: It's Valentine's Day, which means it's time to give chocolate to the boy you like! But an unexpected face makes an appearance…

6.o: It's time for a battle to settle the most important question of all: what do you put on your chicken wings?

7.o: It's time for physicals, and everybody's ready to get naked and get on the scale! Who will be brave enough to go peek at the opposite sex?

8.o: Visha's been working overtime lately. But what does she need the money for?

9.o: It's time for a play! But what kind of play should they put on? Filo will find out!

10.o: It's time for a school festival! But something is lurking outside the school…

11.o: The curtain rises on the school festival! There's a special guest, too…

12.o: The mobile fortress "Destroyer" has joined the last game! It's up to the quartet to grab its headband and win the game.

2.o: An eminent shadow lurks in the school.

3.o: The class works together to grow morning glories.

4.o: The class gets together to cook pasta.

5.o: Motoyasu comes to the school, but he sees every girl he meets as a pig.

6.o: Tanya searches for the identity of the mysterious "Shadow."

7.o: The whole class goes on an exciting ski vacation.

8.o: Everyone starts skipping when a new hit game comes out.

9.o: The classes are suddenly told about an upcoming music festival.

10.o: The day of the music festival arrives, but, naturally, it won't take place without some setbacks.

11.o: The school will have to face a giant zombie bell before receiving the festival prize.

1.o: Ricky decides to audition for East High's fall musical, "High School Musical," in an effort to rekindle his relationship with his ex-girlfriend Nini.

2.o: E.J. is jealous and reeling after losing the leading role of "Troy" to Ricky, and Miss Jenn tells the conflicted leading lady, Nini, to "trust the process."

3.o: After “losing” her phone and missing an important rehearsal, Nini suspects who is responsible for her bout with bad luck and surprisingly retaliates. EJ confronts Ricky about a heartfelt voicemail left for Nini. Meanwhile, Mr. Mazzara becomes suspicious of Miss Jenn's past.

4.o: After Nini discovers that E.J. isn’t who she thinks he is, Ashlyn gets caught in the middle. Gina and E.J. team up as “wonderstudies,” and Ricky gets an unexpected visitor at home.

5.o: Miss Jenn organizes a girl’s night out with Kourtney and Nini to help Nini shake off the boy drama, while the rest of the theater kids attend the East High Homecoming dance, where Carlos learns to dance like everyone’s watching.

6.o: When Miss Jenn is placed on temporary leave and rehearsals are put on hold, the students rally together to defend their drama teacher.

7.o: A rambunctious Thanksgiving "cast party" at Ashlyn's ends with surprising news for Gina, while Miss Jenn and Mr. Mazzara accidentally spend the holiday together at East High.

8.o: When the cast and crew unexpectedly need to find a new location to "tech" their production, Carlos secures a spooky theater downtown, forcing Miss Jenn to confront old demons.

9.o: After months of rehearsals, the theater kids gear up for an unforgettable opening night. But when unexpected audience members show up to shake the cast to its core, will the show "go on" if the Wildcats aren't all in this together?

10.o: It's Act Two of opening night, and the stakes have never been higher. After last-minute cast changes in Act One — and so much left unsaid between Ricky and Nini — there's more drama offstage than on

1.o: Flying high after the triumph of opening night, Ricky, Nini, Gina, and the Wildcats gather at Ashlyn's for a New Year's Eve party. Miss Jenn runs into the new North High rival theatre teacher—a.k.a her ex-boyfriend—and at the stroke of midnight, shocking revelations come to the surface.

2.o: Kourtney, Carlos and Big Red decide to join their friends and audition for on stage roles in "Beauty and the Beast," while Nini experiences FOMO from afar. When new competition shows up to the tryout, Gina tries to shake off some old habits.

3.o: Big Red and Ashlyn celebrate their first Valentine's Day together, amidst drama. Kourtney spars with a co-worker while Gina contends with being single. Meanwhile, Ricky and Nini's plans to surprise each other turn into a comedy of errors, leading to new revelations and a surprise song.

4.o: When a blizzard barrels down on Salt Lake City, the Wildcats are stranded at East High after hours, just as E.J. receives some bad news. As cabin fever sets in, Miss Jenn inspires Nini to make a bold choice about her future; Kourtney's coworker Howie makes a surprising move; and Gina and Carlos come to blows.

5.o: Gina and Seb rally the group to throw Carlos the music and dance-filled Quinceañero he never had. Meanwhile, Ricky accidentally oversteps in more ways than one, and Miss Jenn gets a wild idea about how to get Nini back onstage at East High.

6.o: After rival school North High releases a viral video to undermine the Wildcats, Miss Jenn hosts a weekend improv intensive to build up her kids' confidence. Meanwhile, Nini works on a new song at Salt Lake Slices, where she finds inspiration in Kourtney's approach to life.

7.o: When the Wildcats suspect that North High has stolen a key costume piece, they infiltrate their rival school and end up in a competitive dance-off. Miss Jenn goes face to face and toe to toe with Zack Roy. And an emboldened Nini takes a big risk.

8.o: When the Wildcats are benched from rehearsal for a week, tensions rise to the surface during Career Day. Big Red questions if Ashlyn understands his dreams; Howie makes a surprising move with Kourtney; E.J. shocks his dad with a revelation; and Ricky and Nini visit an old haunt.

9.o: When Gina finds herself stranded at the airport over Spring Break, a surprise run-in changes her mind about what she wants. Meanwhile, the separated Wildcats find a way to bond over song during their break, as Ricky finally sees his mom again after their opening night run-in at "High School Musical."

10.o: After rehearsals fall flat, the cast breaks into separate sleepovers to brainstorm Broadway-worthy ideas to outdo North High. But as the countdown to opening night looms, secrets rise between Nini and Gina, Seb and Carlos suffer their first fight, and Ricky receives an unexpected FaceTime call.

11.o: It's opening night, and Nini hypes up her anxious castmates for their performance in front of the competition judge. But no East High opening night is complete without unexpected visitors, second chances, and big decisions about everyone's futures—together and apart.

12.o: While the Wildcats head to Salt Lake Slices to digest the excitement of opening night - and a pizza or two - Miss Jenn continues to experience tunnel vision over the Menkie Awards. Mr. Mazzara shows his softer side; Ricky reevaluates a party crasher; Gina speaks her truth; and Nini makes a life-altering call.

1.o: After his wife is killed in a car accident, Dr. Andrew Brown moves his 15-year-old son, Ephram, and 9-year-old daughter, Delia, to the idyllic environs of Everwood to make a new start. In the opener, the relocation sparks harsh words and hurt feelings between the emotionally distant father and his neglected son, despite Andrew's attempts to reconnect with the teen. The good doctor also runs afoul of the town's only other physician when he decides to open his own practice---right across the street from his rival's office.

2.o: Andy  and Ephram's fragile relationship is further strained when it appears that Andy is once again putting work before family. Meanwhile, as the town of Everwood celebrates its annual Fall Thaw Festival, Ephram's interest in Amy continues to blossom.  Although Bright tells Ephram that Amy is using him just go get his father to get Colin out of coma. Delia gets into trouble at school for questioning her teacher's antiquated rules.

3.o: Andy's neighbor and friend Nina (Stephanie Niznik) is ostracized by the townspeople when they discover she is a surrogate mother for a woman in her mid-50s. مع بداية الموسم الجديد، تعلو التوقعات بعد مشوار مثير إلى نهائي دوري الأبطال 2019 وصفقات صيفية كبرى، لكن النتائج في الأشهر الأولى مخيبة والفريق يتراجع في الترتيب، ما يجبر رئيس النادي على قرار صعب. فهل يؤتي ثماره؟

2.o: حقبة جديدة يقودها أحد أشهر المدربين في عالم كرة القدم، الذي يتسلم المهمة قبيل ديربي لندني مهم أمام وست هام، وبينما يسعى لكسب القلوب والعقول، يتعين على اللاعبين إثبات أنفسهم لحجز مكان في تشكيلته.

3.o: يتلقى الفريق أول هزيمة تحت قيادة المدرب أمام ناديه السابق مانشستر يونايتد، ويسعى للعودة إلى الانتصارات لتسلق الترتيب وإنهاء الموسم في مراكز دوري الأبطال، فيما يسعى النادي إلى حسم مستقبل عدد من لاعبيه.

4.o: إنه عيد الميلاد، ويواجه المدرب أول تحدٍّ كبير له في النادي؛ إذ تجبره قائمة الإصابات المتزايدة على اللجوء إلى الأكاديمية وإعادة التفكير في اختياراته، فيجد شاب من أبناء المنطقة نفسه فجأة ضمن الفريق الأول. فهل يملك ما يلزم لتحقيق حلم حياته؟

5.o: فترة الانتقالات الشتوية في أوجها، وهي أول فرصة للمدرب لوضع بصمته على الفريق، وهي مهمة أكثر إلحاحًا مع سعي النادي لحسم مستقبل اثنين من أقدم لاعبيه، ومع اقتراب الموعد النهائي تقترب مباراة حاسمة أمام حامل اللقب مانشستر سيتي.

6.o: بعد فوز كبير على البطل مانشستر سيتي، يواجه الفريق قائمة إصابات متنامية بغياب طويل لاثنين من أبرز لاعبيه، ومع استمرار المنافسة على ثلاث جبهات، يعتمد المدرب بشدة على نجمه الكوري لقيادة الهجوم. فهل تهدد إصابة مدمرة أخرى بإنهاء موسمه؟

7.o: بعد أربعة أشهر في المنصب، يجد المدرب نفسه وسط سلسلة نتائج صعبة، ومع خوض الفريق الأدوار الإقصائية في بطولتين، تُمنح شارة القيادة لأحد خريجي الأكاديمية ويشارك الحارس البديل أساسيًا لأول مرة، فيما يتبادل صديقان في الفريق حديثًا صريحًا بعد خسارة.

8.o: موسم الفريق معلق في الميزان؛ فهو لا يزال يقاتل على جبهتين، مع مباراة لا بد من الفوز فيها أمام لايبزيغ في دوري الأبطال والبقاء في سباق المربع الذهبي، لكن مع تركيزه على آخر عشر مباريات، يطال أثر جائحة كورونا النادي ولاعبيه.

9.o: مع استئناف الموسم، أمام الفريق ثماني مباريات لضمان المشاركة الأوروبية، ويتعين على المدرب اجتياز مواجهات صعبة منها ديربي شمال لندن أمام آرسنال، ويظهر أثر الضغط في مشادة بين القائد والنجم الكوري داخل الملعب، ومع اقتراب أطول موسم في تاريخ النادي من نهايته، يودّع الفريق اثنين من قدامى لاعبيه.
